title.zh: 工艺选择：先找主要反射界面
title.en: Process selection: identify the dominant reflecting interface

subtitle.zh: 衬底反射 / 胶面反射 / 浸没保护 / 图形转移
subtitle.en: Substrate reflection / resist-surface reflection / immersion protection / transfer

body.zh: 按主反射来源与集成负担选BARC、TARC、组合或不加ARC。下层复杂膜堆反射强而胶上较弱：优先BARC。胶上表面/浸没界面关键、胶下较弱：优先TARC/Topcoat。上下反射均强、相互干涉显著：组合BARC+TARC。现有膜堆已有效控制反射或新增集成负担大：可不加额外ARC。图中分别标入射光、上下界面反射、浸没液、PR及衬底/下层膜堆。
body.en: Choose BARC, TARC, both or no added ARC by dominant reflection and integration burden. Strong lower-stack reflection: prefer BARC. Dominant upper/immersion interface: prefer TARC/topcoat. Strong upper/lower reflection and interference: combine them. Already-controlled reflection or excessive added burden: no extra ARC. Diagrams label incident light, upper/lower reflection, immersion liquid, PR and lower stack/substrate.

body.zh: 明确波长与光学条件（i-line、DUV、193i、EUV，干式/浸没，NA与偏振）→ 建立含所有功能层的完整膜堆和窗口 → 分析各界面反射及主干涉源 → 扫描ARC参数并仿真容差 → 检查涂布均匀、显影窗口、刻蚀选择比及后续兼容 → FEM与缺陷验证光学、成像和风险。
body.en: Define wavelength/conditions (i-line, DUV, 193i, EUV; dry/immersion; NA/polarization) → build full functional stack/window → analyze reflections/dominant interference → scan ARC parameters/tolerance → check coating, development, selectivity and compatibility → verify optics, imaging and defects using FEM/testing.

body.zh: 控制n/k与膜厚窗口、衬底多层反射、PR厚度预算和显影/刻蚀兼容。PR厚度须满足分辨率与成像、匹配Topcoat并避免过厚问题；去除干净、选择比合适、不增新缺陷。新增ARC可扩大窗口与容差，也增加成本、缺陷机会、复杂度和后续耦合。
body.en: Control n/k/thickness window, multilayer substrate reflection, PR thickness budget and develop/etch compatibility. PR thickness must satisfy resolution/imaging, match topcoat and avoid excessive-thickness issues. Ensure clean removal, appropriate selectivity and no new defects. Added ARC may improve window/tolerance but adds cost, defects, complexity and downstream coupling.

body.zh: 主反射界面误判导致方案错、抑制差；仿真实测不符可能是材料参数或工艺波动；BARC难开口导致残留、CD偏差；TARC难去除导致残留污染。用反射率比较方案，膜厚/n/k确认稳定性，FEM分析成像/强度，CDU评估CD与窗口，缺陷图查表面图形，刻蚀后截面验证转移、残留与损伤。
body.en: Wrong dominant-interface identification gives poor ARC choice/suppression. Simulation mismatch may reflect material parameters or process variation. Hard BARC opening causes residue/CD shift; hard TARC removal causes contamination. Compare reflectance, verify thickness/n/k stability, analyze FEM imaging/intensity, assess CDU/window, map defects and inspect post-etch transfer/residue/damage.

heading.zh: 曝光体系边界：原图概括

body.zh: 原图概括：i-line反射相对易控，通常以BARC为主，可不加TARC；DUV反射更强，常需BARC或TARC并优化胶膜；193i关注浸没界面，常用TARC/Topcoat并组合BARC；多层胶干涉复杂，需考虑各层匹配；EUV反射机理不同，不沿用传统ARC方案，依赖吸收与图形设计。具体策略随波长、胶结构和集成要求变化。
body.en: The source summarizes i-line as relatively easier to control, often BARC-led with optional TARC; DUV as stronger-reflection and needing ARC/resist optimization; 193i as immersion-interface-sensitive with topcoat/TARC and BARC combinations; multilayer resist as requiring complex layer matching; and EUV as a different reflection regime that does not simply reuse traditional ARC approaches. Actual strategy depends on wavelength, resist structure and integration.

notes.zh: 底部各曝光体系为原图定性概括，并非对所有材料与节点的通用配方；EUV等体系不能直接套用前面的可见/DUV示意堆栈。
notes.en: The bottom exposure-system comparisons are qualitative source summaries, not universal recipes for all materials/nodes. EUV and other systems must not directly inherit the earlier visible/DUV schematic stacks.
